name: Bevy
description: A data-driven game engine built in Rust.
summary: Bevy allows careful, human-driven AI assistance for some code-related contributions, provided the AI use is disclosed and the human contributor takes full responsibility and can explain the work. AI-generated prose for documentation, issues, PR descriptions and release notes is banned, as are AI-generated media and AI-authored commits.

evidence.quote: Disclosure. Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.

As a contributor, you are responsible for everything you submit. You must personally understand every line of code or documentation that you put forward for review, and be able to articulate the design rationale and implementation tradeoffs when asked.
No AI-authored commits. Only humans can be commit authors or listed as Co-authored-by.
No AI-generated prose. AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
